002package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IDefinition;
005import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.INamedInstance;
006
007import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
008
009public abstract class AbstractDefinitionNodeItem<D extends IDefinition, I extends INamedInstance>
010    extends AbstractNodeItem
011    implements IFeatureOrhpanedDefinitionNodeItem<D, I> {
012
013  @NonNull
014  private final D definition;
015
016  public AbstractDefinitionNodeItem(@NonNull D definition) {
017    this.definition = definition;
018  }
019
020  @Override
021  public D getDefinition() {
022    return definition;
023  }
024}
